title: LogT: Logically Think with Images for Visual Search
title_zh: LogT：用图像进行逻辑推理，实现细粒度视觉搜索
abstract_en: Thinking with images empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to use an external Zoom-in tool for fine-grained visual search. Recent works employ supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with tool-specific designs to enable such capabilities. However, achieving logical reasoning alongside accurate and efficient tool use remains a significant challenge. To address this, we shift the focus away from increasing RL complexity and instead identify SFT data quality as a key bottleneck. We then propose LogT (short for Logically Think with Images), a fully automated SFT data engine that explicitly enforces logic-chain-guided reasoning. LogT generates an SFT dataset featuring challenging, visually grounded questions and structured tool-use traces with human-like logic. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two base models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, on the dataset and evaluating them across seven benchmark test sets. We show that LogT-SFT based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B outperforms the state-of-the-art trained with both SFT and RL, despite using 3.1times less data and >120times fewer GPU hours. Furthermore, applying a simple RL recipe without tool-specific design on LogT-SFT yields a model that surpasses prior methods with complex RL setups by a substantial 9.59-point margin. In addition to strong performance gains, our model exhibits higher tool-use accuracy and efficiency, as well as more structured and logically consistent reasoning traces, directly validating the effectiveness of our approach.
abstract_zh: 借助外部 Zoom-in 工具，视觉语言模型（VLMs）可以放大局部区域，开展细粒度视觉搜索。现有方法通常结合监督微调（SFT）和针对工具专门设计的强化学习（RL），但仍难以同时做到推理连贯、工具调用准确且高效。本文将重点从增加 RL 的复杂度转向提升 SFT 数据质量，提出全自动数据生成引擎 LogT（Logically Think with Images）。LogT 显式要求推理遵循逻辑链，生成必须依据图像内容作答的高难度问题，以及具有类人逻辑的结构化工具调用轨迹。作者在生成的数据集上微调 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 InternVL3.5-8B，并在 7 个基准测试集上评估。基于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的 LogT-SFT 仅使用约 1/3.1 的训练数据和不到 1/120 的 GPU 小时数，便超过此前结合 SFT 和 RL 的最先进方法。在 LogT-SFT 上进一步采用不针对工具做专门设计的简单 RL，所得模型比采用复杂 RL 方案的既有方法高出 9.59 分。模型的工具调用也更准确、更高效，推理轨迹更有条理、逻辑更一致。
key_points_zh: LogT 将 SFT 数据质量视为关键瓶颈，而非继续提高工具专用 RL 的复杂度。
全自动数据引擎以逻辑链约束样本生成，同时产出依赖图像证据的高难度问题和结构化 Zoom-in 调用轨迹。
在两个基座模型和 7 个基准测试集上验证；基于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的 LogT-SFT 以约 1/3.1 的数据量和不到 1/120 的 GPU 小时数超过此前的 SFT+RL 最佳方法。
在 LogT-SFT 上加入简单 RL 后，模型比采用复杂 RL 方案的既有方法高 9.59 分，同时表现出更准确、高效的工具调用和更一致的推理轨迹。
